m1-is-git-tracked.title: Fix the BLOCK: is_git_tracked mis-answers for a relative path
m1-is-git-tracked.imperative: scripts/install_constellation.py is_git_tracked() passes str(path) as the git ls-files pathspec while cwd=str(path.parent); when path is relative (e.g. produced by --project .), that parent is also relative and resolves against the process's REAL cwd, doubling the parent segment so a tracked file reads as untracked. Fix by resolving path to absolute (path.resolve()) before both the subprocess cwd and the pathspec, so the answer no longer depends on relative vs absolute input. Also verify this repairs check_hooks_shippable (readiness item 3), which shares the same predicate -- no separate code change expected there, just confirm by test. TDD: first attest c1 (new relative-path test added to tests/test_install_constellation.py's ReadinessHooksCheckTests, observed FAILING against the pre-fix predicate -- manual attest, check MUST be null), then implement, then satisfy c2.

preconditions.satisfied_by: m0-context complete: doctrine + handoff loaded and confirmed complete

postconditions.statement: TDD red: new test reproducing the relative-path shape (repo root cwd, relative path e.g. Path('.claude')/'settings.local.json') added and observed FAILING against the pre-fix is_git_tracked -- manual attest, check MUST be null
is_git_tracked resolves path to absolute before asking git; the new test plus the full ReadinessHooksCheckTests class and the source-wiring refusal tests pass

constraints: do not refactor is_git_tracked beyond the absolute-path fix

m4-hook-actually-executes.title: Fix test_every_wired_command_actually_executes to assert real output, not just exit 0
m4-hook-actually-executes.imperative: tests/test_install_constellation.py::AllFourHookWiringTests::test_every_wired_command_actually_executes claims a wrong event argument would be caught but only asserts returncode == 0; scripts/hooks/spine_rail.py fail-opens (prints nothing, exits 0) for ANY unrecognized event, so a wrong event arg is invisible to this test today. TDD: attest c1 (mutate HOOK_SPECS' Stop args to a wrong event string and SessionStart's to no args, same as the cold reviewer's reproduction, run this test alone, observe it FAIL against the rewritten body -- manual attest, check MUST be null, then revert the mutation), then satisfy c2.

why_trail.why: Handoff is a cold-review fix list for 5 items across 4 merged PRs on integrate/wave1-fixes: (1) is_git_tracked in scripts/install_constellation.py doubles the parent segment for a relative path because it passes str(path) as pathspec with cwd=str(path.parent), both relative -- fix by path.resolve() before both; also backs check_hooks_shippable via the same predicate, verify by test, no separate code change expected. (2)+(3) tests/test_interpreter_portability.py has two tautological self-tests (test_detector_would_not_go_green_on_empty_discovery tests unittest itself; test_detector_actually_fires_on_a_constructed_drift never calls _tracked_hook_entries) -- rewrite both to genuinely exercise the real discovery functions with subprocess.run/TRACKED_SETTINGS patched. (4) tests/test_install_constellation.py::test_every_wired_command_actually_executes only checks returncode==0, but spine_rail.py fail-opens (prints nothing, exits 0) on ANY unrecognized event arg -- rewrite to assert real stdout/side-effect against a constructed mid-flight spine state for the 3 spine_rail-backed entries; leave gauge_writer's check as exit-code since it takes no event arg. (5) scripts/run_crew.py WORK_ID_SEGMENT_RE and scripts/verify_iterative_role_artifacts.py SAFE_ID are the same grammar, unpinned -- add a pin test in tests/test_work_id_nesting.py matching test_the_two_run_grammars_are_the_same_grammar's style. Constraints: no shared module (duplication+pin is sanctioned), encoding=utf-8/newline=\n on writes, python -m pytest never python3, baseline 2263 passed/1 skipped/0 failed, count must only go up, work only in this worktree, do not push/PR, demonstrate red for every fix. Plan built with 7 gates (context + 5 fixes + final full-suite verify), each fix gate TDD-attests a manual red observation before its command-check green. Nothing yet implemented -- next actor starts m1-is-git-tracked.

Fixed is_git_tracked in scripts/install_constellation.py: resolves path to absolute FIRST (path.resolve()), then derives both subprocess cwd and the pathspec from that resolved path, so a relative --project . path no longer doubles the parent segment against git. TDD: added test_is_git_tracked_true_for_a_relative_path_from_the_repo_root to ReadinessHooksCheckTests (chdir into a temp repo, git-add+commit .claude/settings.local.json, call is_git_tracked with a RELATIVE Path('.claude')/'settings.local.json') -- observed RED (AssertionError: False is not true) against the pre-fix code, then implemented the fix, then green. check_hooks_shippable needed no separate change since it calls is_git_tracked directly -- confirmed by running the whole ReadinessHooksCheckTests class plus both source-wiring refusal tests (test_source_wiring_refuses_a_git_tracked_local_settings_file, test_the_same_run_succeeds_when_the_local_file_is_untracked): 10 passed.
